title: Pure Neo-Spacian
summary: Jaden Yuki's Neo-Spacian archetype combines the six Level 3 elemental aliens (Aqua Dolphin, Dark Panther, Grand Mole, Flare Scarab, Air Hummingbird, and Glow Moss) with Elemental HERO Neos for Contact Fusions that shuffle materials from the field into the Deck without Polymerization! Normal Summon Neo Space Connector to pull Neo-Spacian Aqua Dolphin from your Deck, then tribute Connector to revive Elemental HERO Neos from your GY, or activate Neos Fusion and Miracle Contact to bring out triple-Contact bosses like Elemental HERO Cosmo Neos (which locks your opponent out of activating any cards or effects on the field for the entire turn!) and Elemental HERO Nebula Neos!

allow.Elemental HERO Spirit of Neos: Special Summons itself when an opponent attacks, searches ANY Spell/Trap that mentions 'Elemental HERO Neos' on Special Summon, and tags out into Elemental HERO Neos from your Deck!
allow.Cross Keeper: Discards itself from hand to Special Summon a Neo-Spacian or Elemental HERO from your hand or GY, and banishes from GY when you Fusion Summon an Elemental HERO to draw 2 cards and bottom-deck 1!
allow.EN - Engage Neo Space: Sends 1 Neo-Spacian and 1 Elemental HERO from your hand AND Deck to the GY to Special Summon Spirit of Neos directly from your Deck AND adds Polymerization!
allow.Reinforcement of the Army: Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Neo Space Connector.
allow.Xtra HERO Infernal Devicer: Link-2 Fiend HERO that reveals Nebula Neos or Cosmo Neos in your Extra Deck on Link Summon to add up to 2 of the listed Neo-Spacian Fusion Materials directly from your Deck to your hand.

main: Neo Space Connector

Core 1-card starter: when Normal Summoned, Special Summons any 'Neo-Spacian' monster or 'Elemental HERO Neos' from your hand or Deck in Defense Position; tributes itself to Special Summon 1 'Neo-Spacian' or 'Elemental HERO Neos' from your GY!
Neo-Spacian Aqua Dolphin
Level 3 WATER Warrior: discards 1 card once per turn to look at your opponent's entire hand and destroy 1 monster in their hand with ATK less than or equal to a monster you control!
Neo-Spacian Grand Mole
Level 3 EARTH Rock: at the start of the Damage Step, when this card battles an opponent's monster, returns BOTH monsters to the hand without damage calculation or targeting!
Neo-Spacian Dark Panther
Level 3 DARK Beast: targets 1 face-up monster your opponent controls to copy its name AND effects until the End Phase.
Neo-Spacian Air Hummingbird
Level 3 WIND Winged Beast: gains 500 LP once per turn for each card in your opponent's hand.
Neo-Spacian Flare Scarab
Level 3 FIRE Insect: gains 400 ATK for each Spell/Trap your opponent controls.
Neo-Spacian Glow Moss
Level 3 LIGHT Plant: makes your opponent draw 1 card when battling and ends the Battle Phase if it is a Monster.
Elemental HERO Neos
Iconic Level 7 LIGHT Warrior (2500 ATK): required material for all Contact Fusions, Neos Fusion, and Miracle Contact.
Elemental HERO Spirit of Neos
Summoned by EN - Engage Neo Space; searches Neos Fusion, Miracle Contact, Convert Contact, or NEXT on Special Summon, and tags out into Elemental HERO Neos from your Deck!
Cross Keeper
Summons a Neo-Spacian or Neos from hand/GY and draws 2 cards when you Special Summon a Neos Fusion Monster.
EN - Engage Neo Space
Sends 1 Neo-Spacian and 1 Elemental HERO from hand + Deck to GY to Special Summon Spirit of Neos from your Deck and adds Polymerization.
Neos Fusion
Core Spell: Special Summons any Fusion Monster that lists exactly 2 monsters as material, including 'Elemental HERO Neos', by sending materials from hand, Deck, or field to GY.
Miracle Contact
Core Spell: shuffles Elemental HERO Neos and Neo-Spacians from hand, field, and/or GY into the Deck to Special Summon ANY 'Elemental HERO' Fusion Monster that lists 'Elemental HERO Neos' as material!
Convert Contact
If you control no monsters, sends 1 Neo-Spacian from hand and 1 from Deck to GY to draw 2 cards!
NEXT
Signature Trap: Special Summons any number of 'Neo-Spacian' monsters and 'Elemental HERO Neos' with different names from your hand and/or GY—instantly assembling a Contact Fusion!
Reinforcement of the Army
Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Neo Space Connector.
extra: Ultimate Level 11 Contact Fusion boss: when Special Summoned from the Extra Deck, prevents your opponent from activating cards or effects on the field for the rest of that turn; destroys all cards your opponent controls during the End Phase!

Level 9 Contact Fusion boss: draws cards equal to the number of cards your opponent controls on Special Summon, negates 1 face-up card, and banishes all cards on the field face-down during the End Phase!
Level 7 Fusion: gains 100 ATK per Neo-Spacian/HERO in your GY and searches any Spell/Trap mentioning 'Elemental HERO Neos' when destroying a monster by battle.
Level 7 Contact Fusion ('Elemental HERO Neos' + 'Neo-Spacian Aqua Dolphin') that discards 1 card to destroy 1 random card in your opponent's hand.
Level 7 Contact Fusion ('Elemental HERO Neos' + 'Neo-Spacian Grand Mole') that bounces 1 monster your opponent controls to the hand once per turn.
Level 7 Contact Fusion ('Elemental HERO Neos' + 'Neo-Spacian Dark Panther') that negates 1 Effect Monster on the field.
Link-2 Fiend HERO that reveals Nebula Neos or Cosmo Neos in your Extra Deck on Link Summon to add up to 2 of the listed Neo-Spacian Fusion Materials directly from your Deck to your hand!
